name: Quarterly privileged access review
description: Review privileged accounts every quarter
rationale: Reviews are performed but evidence is incomplete for two applications.

name: Privileged access misuse
description: Unauthorized elevated access can lead to data exposure
rationale: Residual risk remains high because reviews and MFA coverage are incomplete.

name: Vendor due diligence refresh
description: Refresh third-party assurance and contract controls
rationale: No current SOC report or exit plan is recorded for two critical vendors.

name: Critical supplier outage
description: Third-party service disruption can affect customer operations
rationale: Concentration risk is high and assurance documents are outdated.

name: Backup restore testing
description: Test restore procedures for critical systems
rationale: Latest restore test completed successfully.

name: Delayed data recovery
description: Recovery delays could disrupt reporting processes
rationale: Residual risk is within appetite after successful restore tests.

name: Multi-factor authentication enforcement
description: Enforce MFA for privileged and remote access
rationale: Legacy remote access path does not enforce MFA for all users.

name: Credential theft through phishing
description: Compromised credentials can enable unauthorized access
rationale: Recent simulations show increased click rates and incomplete MFA coverage.

name: Policy exception review
description: Review and approve exceptions to security policy
rationale: Exception register exists but overdue exceptions are not escalated consistently.

name: Policy non-compliance
description: Unmanaged exceptions can lead to inconsistent control operation
rationale: Residual risk is moderate because exception aging is not consistently monitored.

name: User deprovisioning timeliness
description: Ensure timely removal of access for departing employees
rationale: Deprovisioning is performed but delays of up to 5 days were observed in several cases.

name: Orphaned user accounts
description: Inactive accounts may be misused for unauthorized access
rationale: Delayed deprovisioning increases the likelihood of misuse.

name: Patch management cadence
description: Apply security patches within defined timelines
rationale: Patch compliance is above 95% for critical systems.

name: System vulnerabilities
description: Unpatched systems can be exploited by attackers
rationale: Residual risk reduced due to strong patch compliance.

name: Logging and monitoring coverage
description: Monitor critical systems and log security events
rationale: Logging is enabled but not all critical applications are included.

name: Undetected security incidents
description: Lack of monitoring may delay detection of attacks
rationale: Incomplete log coverage limits detection capabilities.

name: Data classification enforcement
description: Classify data based on sensitivity and apply controls
rationale: Data classification policy exists but is not consistently applied.

name: Improper data handling
description: Unclassified data may be exposed or mishandled
rationale: Inconsistent classification leads to unclear protection requirements.

name: Incident response testing
description: Conduct regular incident response simulations
rationale: Recent tabletop exercise demonstrated effective coordination.

name: Ineffective incident response
description: Weak response capabilities can prolong impact of incidents
rationale: Residual risk reduced following successful simulations.

name: Segregation of duties enforcement
description: Enforce SoD controls in critical financial systems
rationale: Conflicting roles exist for a small number of users without mitigation controls.

name: Unauthorized transactions
description: Lack of segregation may enable fraudulent or erroneous transactions
rationale: Residual risk remains due to unmitigated conflicts.

name: Business continuity plan update
description: Maintain and update BCP documentation annually
rationale: BCP exists but was not updated after recent organizational changes.

name: Operational disruption
description: Outdated continuity plans may not reflect current risks
rationale: Changes in structure and systems are not reflected in BCP.

name: Third-party access control
description: Restrict and monitor vendor access to systems
rationale: Vendor access is not centrally logged or periodically reviewed.

name: Excessive vendor access
description: Overprivileged vendor accounts may lead to breaches
rationale: Lack of monitoring and review increases exposure.

name: Change approval workflow
description: Formal approval required for all production changes
rationale: All sampled changes had documented approvals.

name: Unauthorized system changes
description: Unapproved changes may disrupt operations or introduce risk
rationale: Control effectiveness reduces likelihood significantly.
